title: Storming Feng City
summary: Su Qian leads the Jia Nan Academy, with Xiao Li's men, against Han Feng's Black Alliance at its headquarters, Feng City. Han Feng, who had planned to strike first, wants the complete Flame Mantra from Xiao Yan. On the way Xiao Yan asks to keep Han Feng's Sea Heart Flame, and Su Qian says he knows Xiao Yan is linked to Yao Zun Zhe and will keep the secret. At Feng City, Su Qian takes Mr. Jin and Mr. Yin while Xiao Yan fights Han Feng, who offers him the Black Alliance for the Flame Mantra and is refused. Xiao Yan's merged flames break down the Sea Heart Flame, but Han Feng shows he is close to Dou Zong. Han Feng's Brilliance Seal meets Xiao Yan's Flame Splitting Tsunami, and when Han Feng mocks him for running out of Dou Qi, Xiao Yan says he has fallen into the same trap twice.
